executionProtocol.cadence: Full pass on an isolated Mark Test build before every train candidate freeze (docs/release-trains/README.md); targeted category passes after repairs touching that surface.
executionProtocol.recording: Set status/lastRun/notes per item after each execution; a failed item stays failed until its repair lands and the item is re-executed on the repaired build.
executionProtocol.automatedFloor: The affordance audit (tests/renderer/commands/shortcut-routing-audit.test.js + tests/e2e/affordance-audit.spec.ts) and the full CI suite run on every push; this checklist is the human breadth pass above that floor, focused on what automation cannot see (feel, timing, native surfaces).

tests.name: Cold start dark theme — no white flash
tests.steps: Launch app with dark theme cached → observe first frame
tests.expected: Window background is dark from frame 1, no white flash

tests.name: Cold start light theme — no dark flash
tests.steps: Set light theme → relaunch
tests.expected: Window background is light from frame 1

tests.name: First-ever launch (no cache) — system dark
tests.steps: Clear localStorage → system dark mode → launch
tests.expected: CSS media query fallback sets dark background

tests.name: Session restore reopens tabs and scroll positions
tests.steps: Open 3 files, scroll each, quit → relaunch
tests.expected: Same tabs open, scroll approximately preserved, no blank-until-scroll regression
tests.notes: Blank-until-scroll class fixed in 81213fe0/650a555f — keep watching

tests.name: Watchdog fires on stuck boot
tests.steps: Break JS module load → wait 5s
tests.expected: Error overlay appears after 5s timeout

tests.name: Action row buttons fire
tests.steps: Close all tabs → welcome shows → click Open File / Open Folder / New
tests.expected: Each button opens its dialog or creates a tab; nothing is a dead click

tests.name: Last session row restores session
tests.steps: Close all tabs → click “Last session”
tests.expected: Previous session tabs reopen; not a dead click
tests.notes: FIX-009 open (2026-10-20) — reported broken; verify after its repair

tests.name: Recent files/folders rows open their target
tests.steps: Click several recent files and one folder
tests.expected: File opens in a tab; folder opens as project sidebar

tests.name: Remove recent + Undo toast
tests.steps: Context-menu remove a recent → Undo in toast
tests.expected: Row disappears and restores in exact order

tests.name: Agent prompt copy chip writes clipboard
tests.steps: Click Copy prompt
tests.expected: Clipboard contains the agent prompt text

tests.name: All theme families switch live
tests.steps: Settings/theme picker → walk Paper, Ink, Docs, macOS and the six family members
tests.expected: Editor, sidebar, title bar update instantly in both light and dark

tests.name: Theme toggle button pairs
tests.steps: Click sun/moon toggle in title bar
tests.expected: Switches to the paired light/dark member of the current family

tests.name: Theme persistence across restart
tests.steps: Set a non-default theme → quit → relaunch
tests.expected: Same theme loads, localStorage matches

tests.name: Dialogs and floats follow the theme
tests.steps: Trigger a confirmation dialog and a context menu on dark theme
tests.expected: Dialog/menu use app float tokens — no light box on dark editor

tests.name: Custom CSS applied on top of theme
tests.steps: Settings → Custom CSS → add rule
tests.expected: Rule visible in DOM, overrides theme

tests.name: Local appearance modes (Auto/Light/Dark) cycle correctly
tests.steps: Switch appearance mode with system theme changing
tests.expected: Auto follows system; manual picks stick and clear follow-mode

tests.name: Rust code — VS Code Dark+ colors
tests.steps: Insert rust code block with fn, let, struct, String
tests.expected: Keywords pink, functions yellow, types teal, strings orange-ish

tests.name: JavaScript code — token separation
tests.steps: Insert JS code with class, function, parameter, const
tests.expected: class-name teal, function yellow, parameter distinct color

tests.name: Code blocks on light themes readable
tests.steps: Switch to light theme → insert code block
tests.expected: Syntax colors visible and readable on light background

tests.name: Line numbers and wrap options persist
tests.steps: Toggle code block line numbers + wrap in Settings
tests.expected: Preference applies to new and existing code blocks after reload

tests.name: Flowchart/sequence render on dark and light
tests.steps: Insert mermaid-syntax flowchart and sequenceDiagram on both appearances
tests.expected: Diagrams render via pele with theme-matching colors and contrast

tests.name: Diagram appearance options apply
tests.steps: Change sequence theme / hand style in diagram appearance panel
tests.expected: Diagrams re-render with the chosen options; no stale cache

tests.name: Invalid diagram shows error, no crash
tests.steps: Insert invalid mermaid syntax
tests.expected: Error placeholder shown, editor stays alive

tests.name: Inline and block math render
tests.steps: Type $e^{i\pi}+1=0$ and a $$ block integral
tests.expected: Both render as formatted math

tests.name: Invalid math shows error
tests.steps: Type $\invalid{broken}$
tests.expected: Error indicator, not a crash

tests.name: Insert image via markdown syntax
tests.steps: Type ![alt](path/to/image.png)
tests.expected: Image renders inline in WYSIWYG mode

tests.name: Paste image from clipboard
tests.steps: Copy image → paste in editor
tests.expected: Image saved per preference, inserted with path

tests.name: Drag-drop image file
tests.steps: Drag PNG/JPG from Finder onto editor
tests.expected: Image inserted at drop position

tests.name: Relative image path resolution
tests.steps: Open .md with relative image paths
tests.expected: Images resolve relative to the .md location

tests.name: Broken image path shows placeholder
tests.steps: Insert nonexistent image path
tests.expected: Broken placeholder, no crash

tests.name: WYSIWYG default editing
tests.steps: Open file → edit bold/italic/headings/lists
tests.expected: Rich rendering with live format updates

tests.name: Source mode toggle preserves content
tests.steps: Edit in WYSIWYG → ⌥⌘S source mode → edit → back
tests.expected: Content preserved both directions, cursor sane

tests.name: Typewriter and focus modes
tests.steps: Enable each → type
tests.expected: Cursor centering / paragraph dimming as configured

tests.name: Split View (⌥⌘\) mirror stays live
tests.steps: Toggle Split View → edit in CodeMirror pane
tests.expected: Muya mirror re-renders within ~150ms–2s; no ghost edits; toggle off returns cleanly

tests.name: Read-only lock (View › Lock Document)
tests.steps: Lock a tab → try editing and transforming
tests.expected: Surface read-only, lock sticky against click-to-exit, shortcuts suppressed

tests.name: Fullscreen block viewer zoom and keys
tests.steps: Open table/diagram fullscreen → +/−/0/1 keys and wheel
tests.expected: Viewer zooms itself, never the editor beneath; close returns exactly

tests.name: New / open / save / save-as round trip
tests.steps: Cmd+N, Cmd+O, edit, Cmd+S, Shift+Cmd+S
tests.expected: Tabs, titles, dirty indicators and disk contents all consistent

tests.name: Close dirty file — save dialog
tests.steps: Edit file → close tab
tests.expected: Dialog: Save / Discard / Cancel; each path leaves correct state

tests.name: Open folder as project
tests.steps: File → Open Folder → pick directory
tests.expected: Sidebar tree shows, files open on click, external changes reload

tests.name: Open from Clipboard (⌥⌘V)
tests.steps: Copy markdown text / a folder path → ⌥⌘V
tests.expected: Text opens as a tab; folder path opens as workspace

tests.name: Auto-save honors delay
tests.steps: Enable auto-save → edit → wait
tests.expected: File written after the configured delay, dirty indicator clears

tests.name: Sidebar TOC clears with its document
tests.steps: Close file → create new document
tests.expected: Right rail/TOC reflects the active document only — no stale navigation

tests.name: Multiple tabs, switching, dirty dots
tests.steps: Open 3+ files, edit two, cycle with Ctrl+Tab both ways
tests.expected: Tabs render, correct dirty state, cycling wraps

tests.name: Close active tab keeps ownership
tests.steps: Open 3 tabs → rapid-close the active one → type immediately
tests.expected: Editor shows the newly selected tab; edits land in THAT document
tests.notes: C-TAB-CLOSE-OWNERSHIP: verify with fast timing, not just calm clicks

tests.name: Switch during background render
tests.steps: Open a large file → immediately switch to another tab
tests.expected: Late render of the first file never overwrites the second tab's view

tests.name: Tab keyboard navigation
tests.steps: Cmd+Shift+] / [
tests.expected: Cycles forward/backward

tests.name: Tab scroll on overflow
tests.steps: Open 10+ tabs
tests.expected: Tabs scroll horizontally, active tab kept visible

tests.name: Diff against opened version (⌘D)
tests.steps: Edit a saved file → ⌘D → inspect → exit → edit again
tests.expected: Diff shows edits since open; calm notice when unchanged; edits retained after exiting diff

tests.name: Headings H1–H6 via ⌘1–6
tests.steps: Place cursor in paragraphs → ⌘1…⌘6
tests.expected: Each press transforms the paragraph to that heading level
tests.notes: FIX-006 pinned; re-verify on RU layout too

tests.name: Inline formats and task lists
tests.steps: Type **bold**, *italic*, ~~strike~~, ==mark==, - [ ] task
tests.expected: All render; checkbox toggles source

tests.name: Front menu paragraph actions
tests.steps: Open paragraph front menu → duplicate (⇧⌘D), new (⇧⌘N), delete (⇧⌘⌫), turn into submenu
tests.expected: Every displayed shortcut works from keyboard; menu widths fit localized labels

tests.name: Tables: edit, resize, sticky header
tests.steps: Insert table, edit cells, resize column, long-cell table scroll
tests.expected: Cells editable, no phantom scrollbars, counter readable over edge shades

tests.name: Table as image (copy + PNG export)
tests.steps: Fullscreen table viewer → copy as image → export PNG
tests.expected: Clipboard image and saved PNG match the visible table

tests.name: Footnotes, links, anchors
tests.steps: Add footnotes, internal links, Cyrillic headings
tests.expected: Footnote grammar live-updates; anchors slugified correctly

tests.name: ⌘1-6 heading levels
tests.steps: Cmd+1 through Cmd+6 in paragraphs
tests.expected: Paragraph becomes H1–H6

tests.name: Shift-arrow selection with panels open
tests.steps: Select text so format/link/footnote/table panels appear → keep Shift+Up/Down
tests.expected: Selection keeps expanding vertically; panels never swallow keys except active pickers
tests.notes: FIX-001 class; check overlapping hover panels

tests.name: Advertised menu accelerators all fire
tests.steps: Walk every menu item with an accelerator (⌘S ⌘F ⌘T ⌘D ⌥⌘V ⌘, ⌘W ⌘P …)
tests.expected: Each accelerator does what its menu says; no dead chords incl. ⇧⌘P reservation
tests.notes: Automated floor: shortcut-routing-audit.test.js; this is the native-menu human pass

tests.name: Undo/redo across surfaces incl. RU layout
tests.steps: Edit → ⌘Z / ⇧⌘Z (physical Z, RU layout ⌘Я)
tests.expected: History works by physical key in every surface

tests.name: Zoom trio and Ctrl+wheel
tests.steps: ⌘= / ⌘- / ⌘0 and Ctrl+wheel in editor and viewer
tests.expected: Font size steps, actual size restores Settings size; viewer zoom independent

tests.name: Autosave-safe Esc/Enter in floats
tests.steps: Esc out of search bar, pickers, dialogs
tests.expected: Each float closes cleanly, focus returns to editor

tests.name: Find bar and result cycling
tests.steps: ⌘F → type → Enter/Shift+Enter
tests.expected: Matches highlighted, count shown, cycling scrolls

tests.name: Replace single/all
tests.steps: Expand replace → one, then all
tests.expected: Correct replacements, count feedback

tests.name: Go to Heading (⌘T)
tests.steps: ⌘T → type heading text → Enter
tests.expected: Jumps to heading; palette keyboard-owned while open

tests.name: Find in folder
tests.steps: ⇧⌘F over an opened project
tests.expected: Project search returns files+snippets, exclusions respected

tests.name: Outline rail navigation
tests.steps: Use the On-this-page rail while scrolling a long doc with tables
tests.expected: Outline visibility follows the intersection rule; clicks jump accurately

tests.name: Export HTML keeps styles/diagrams/math
tests.steps: File → Export → HTML on a rich doc
tests.expected: Standalone HTML renders pele diagrams and KaTeX with CSS

tests.name: Print panel from ⌘P
tests.steps: ⌘P on a document
tests.expected: Print container renders with remembered options; native panel opens directly

tests.name: PDF export
tests.steps: File → Export → PDF
tests.expected: PDF layout matches editor appearance

tests.name: Settings window opens and routes
tests.steps: ⌘, → walk tabs → reopen
tests.expected: Tabs render, remembered tab restores, ⌘F searches settings

tests.name: Preference changes apply live
tests.steps: Change font size, family, line width
tests.expected: Editor updates immediately; persists across restart

tests.name: Restore defaults + one-time migrations
tests.steps: Restore defaults → relaunch
tests.expected: Clean baseline; no repeated migration prompts

tests.name: What's New sheet opens per release
tests.steps: Help → What's New
tests.expected: Sheet shows current version items in the UI language

tests.name: Guide tab opens localized
tests.steps: Help → Guide
tests.expected: Localized guide opens as a temporary tab

tests.name: Updater flow (desktop builds)
tests.steps: File → Check for Updates (on a build with a feed)
tests.expected: Calm check, toast on available, signed install path

tests.name: RU locale menus and settings fit
tests.steps: Switch to Russian → open menus, settings, front menu
tests.expected: No wrapping/collision of long labels; shortcut column aligned

tests.name: RU physical-key shortcuts
tests.steps: RU layout: ⌘Я undo, ⇧⌘D duplicate, ⌘1–6
tests.expected: Physical-code matching works on Cyrillic layout

tests.name: Quotes/typography pairing
tests.steps: Type quotes with RU text
tests.expected: «» pairing per locale rules

tests.name: Locale switch persistence
tests.steps: Switch language → restart
tests.expected: UI language persists; no mixed-language screens
